'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] and tanks enter [[Khan Yunis]] in the south of the [[Gaza Strip]]. [[Forced displacement|Displaced families]] in the region are heading further south to [[Rafah]], a town on the [[Egypt]]ian border. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-intensifies-southern-gaza-offensive-us-un-urge-civilian-protections-2023-12-05/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/5/israeli-army-surrounds-khan-younis-as-southern-gaza-attacks-intensify (Al Jazeera)]
***More than 100 people are killed in [[airstrike]]s near the Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza, as Israeli forces encircle the [[medical facility]] in use as a shelter. Witnesses say anyone attempting to leave was being shot at by Israeli [[sniper]]s. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/5/northern-gaza-hospital-overwhelmed-by-horror-as-israeli-army-lays-siege (Al Jazeera)] 
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
***A [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese soldier]] is killed and three others are injured by [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] shelling in [[Odaisseh]], [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanese-army-says-one-soldier-killed-israeli-shelling-south-lebanon-2023-12-05/ (Reuters)]
**At the [[Gulf Cooperation Council]] summit, [[Qatar]]i [[List of prime ministers of Qatar|prime minister]] [[Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani|Al Thani]] calls for a permanent [[ceasefire]] in Gaza. '''Business and economy'''
*The [[DAX]] achieves a new record high, increasing by 0.78%, surpassing the previous record from July. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/european-shares-slip-barclays-steers-financials-lower-2023-12-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 eruption of Mount Marapi]]
**More bodies are found by rescuers on the slopes of [[Mount Marapi]] in [[West Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]], bringing the death toll from Sunday's [[Types of volcanic eruptions|volcanic eruption]] to 23. [https://apnews.com/article/mount-marapi-eruption-climbers-fe1ec3fff730eb19a4940e55e85300cb (AP)]
*Seventeen people are killed when a bus falls into a [[ravine]] in [[Hamtic]], [[Antique (province)|Antique]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/world/2023/12/06/kenyan-among-17-killed-in-philippines-bus-crash/106047 (AFP via ''Malay Mail'')]
*Fourteen people are killed and 32 others are injured when a [[double-decker bus]] veers off the road and [[traffic collision|crashes]] into a tree in [[Prachuap Khiri Khan]], [[Thailand]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-bus-crash-deaths-prachuap-bangkok-babf452e55ff0c8c3ab6141390dd1258 (AP)]
*Ten people are killed when a bus falls into a ravine after crashing into a bridge near [[Tegucigalpa]], [[Honduras]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/honduras-bus-crash-leaves-12-dead-dozens-injured (Reuters via ''The Straits Times'')]
*The [[Pacific Northwest]] of the United States [[2023 Pacific Northwest floods|experiences]] an [[atmospheric river]], with record-breaking rainfall reported in [[Washington (state)|Washington]] and [[Oregon]]. One person is killed by flooding in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]], Oregon. [https://apnews.com/article/pacific-northwest-atmospheric-river-rain-oregon-washington-f96cffd40a37a21786ac29f635f4e089 (AP)] [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2023/12/05/weather/pacific-northwest-atmospheric-rivers-rain-tuesday/index.html (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Conservation in New Zealand|New Zealand conservationists]] announce the first birth of [[Kiwi (bird)|kiwi]] birds in the wild area around [[Wellington]] in over a century. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/12/06/world/asia-oceania/wild-born-kiwi-chicks-1st-in-century-cheered-in-nz/1922936 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Diplomatic impact of the 2023 Israel–Hamas war]], [[Israel–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]] announces [[Travel visa|visa]] restrictions for [[Israeli settler violence#Settler extremism|extremist Israeli settlers]] involved in [[Zionist political violence|violence]] against [[Palestinians]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20231205-in-rare-israel-rebuke-us-restricts-visas-on-extremist-settlers (AFP via RFI)]
*[[Rwanda–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Rwanda asylum plan]]
***[[Rwanda]] and the [[United Kingdom]] sign a [[treaty]] in [[Kigali]], Rwanda, on the relocation of [[asylum seeker]]s to Rwanda. The new treaty will also see British [[lawyer]]s stationed in Rwandan courts. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-politics-67612151 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Arrest and trial of Alberto Fujimori]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Peru]] orders the release of former [[President of Peru|President]] [[Alberto Fujimori]], who is serving a 25-year prison [[sentence (law)|sentence]] for [[crimes against humanity]], reinstating a previously revoked [[Pardon of Alberto Fujimori|pardon]] on [[Compassionate release|humanitarian grounds]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231205-%F0%9F%94%B4-peru-s-constitutional-court-orders-release-of-ex-president-alberto-fujimori (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**The [[National Assembly (Ecuador)|National Assembly]] approves the Private Security and Surveillance Law, aimed at strengthening and regulating [[Security company|security companies]] to combat the [[Ecuador|country]]'s rising [[Crime in Ecuador|crime rates]]. [https://english.news.cn/20231206/6abe896470f54bedbfc5c3d3b358fe64/c.html (Xinhua)]
